name: rein
description: Land the conclusions you confirm into an alignment ledger that a hook re-reads on every prompt, so later turns stay aligned. Keeps the main chat clean and makes side chat more useful.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the agent aligned with what you confirmed
interface.longDescription: Confirmed conclusions go into an alignment ledger (ALIGNMENT.md) that a hook re-reads on every prompt, so later turns carry them without you repeating yourself. Questioning an answer can happen in an isolated side chat instead of derailing the main thread; one-off notes can be carried back to the main thread exactly once. Landing works from the main thread and the side chat alike.
